# Getting help

Start with the documentation:

- [README](https://github.com/freethinkingit/inline-email/blob/master/README.md) for installation and a first example.
- [Reference](https://github.com/freethinkingit/inline-email/blob/master/docs/reference.md) for every option and command.
- [Guides](https://github.com/freethinkingit/inline-email/tree/master/docs/guides) for worked examples.

If the documentation does not answer your question, ask it in [Discussions Q&A](https://github.com/freethinkingit/inline-email/discussions/categories/q-a).
Say what you tried and what you expected.

To report a bug or request a feature, [open an issue](https://github.com/freethinkingit/inline-email/issues/new/choose).

Report a security problem privately instead, as [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) describes.
